title: HB1315 (2019-2020 Regular): Concerning concealed pistol license training requirements.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States public data converted to LegiScan layout (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Comm Sub, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/Biennium/2019-20/Htm/Bills/House%20Bills/1315-S.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Substitute House Bill (Comm Sub), HTML with marks. Also restructures RCW 9.41.070: moves the 30/60-day issuance deadlines into (1)(a)-(b), replaces 'applicant's constitutional right to bear arms shall not be denied' with 'An application ... shall not be denied', lists application contents in (7)-(8), and renumbers.
